description: The driver cancels t.a at 50 while it sleeps. The task acknowledges at once (the sleep ends early), is in Cancelling, and its program keeps running its cleanup steps (a checkpoint with on_cancel continue, two traces across a yield) before it ends: Cancelling drains to Finalizing and the task completes Cancelled with the driver's reason, cancellation winning over the body's return (CANCEL-ACKNOWLEDGE, CANCEL-DRAIN, CANCEL-FINALIZE; PROG-CANCEL).
